To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a synaptic membrane glycine, glutamate, and thienyl cyclohexylpideridine-binding protein has been isolated from rat brain synaptic membrane.
we have identified and isolated a 55-60-kDa protein from brain synaptic membranes that binds glycine, NMDAR agonists, and NMDAR antagonists.
a synaptic membrane protein that binds glycine, glutamate, and TCP has been purified and characterized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the purification of a synaptic membrane protein, pG1BP, with high affinity glycine binding sites that are similar to the glycine binding sites of NMDA receptors.
the identification of the proteins that mediate the synaptic actions of the endogenous ligands glycine and glutamate.
the identification of proteins that are components of the NMDA receptor complex.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the anti-43 kD antibodies react with the same protein as pGlyBP.
the 43 kDa protein, pGylBP, and the 55- 60 kDa synaptic membrane protein, are the same protein.
the pGlyBP is the 43 kDa protein that is a subunit of a complex of proteins with glycine-, glutamatergic-, and TCP-binding sites.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a 43 kD protein, which is the product of the pGlyBP gene, has the properties of a glycine-binding subunit of the NMDA receptor complex.
the anti-43 kDA antibodies have been used to isolate and characterize a 60 kDA protein that is highly enriched in glycine, glutamate, and thienyl cyclohexylpirdine binding sites.
a 43 kD protein in synaptic membranes is the precursor for a 60 kD protein that binds glycine and glutamate and that the 60kD protein has a high affinity for the NMDA receptor antagonist MK-801.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the anti-43 kDA antibody recognizes the 60 kD protein.
the 43 kDa protein is a glycoprotein with high affinity glycine binding sites and that the protein is a component of a synaptic membrane complex with glycine, glutamate and TCP binding sites.
the 60kDa protein is the same as the 43kDa protein we cloned previously and it has glycine and glutamate binding sites and a high affinity site for TCP.
